section_summary: This section documents State and War Department processing of civilian entry into occupied Japan, including business quotas, missionary clearances, family reunification, personal visits and airline transit. Much of the correspondence concerns military permits, SCAP Circular No. 8 documentation, security name checks and communications with foreign embassies or consulates. It also covers the proposed repatriation of Julio Hideo and Alfonso Sumio Fushimi from Japan to Argentina.

subfiles.title: File memorandum on delayed clearance for Powles, Foerstel and Powell
subfiles.about: Records the delayed receipt and uncertain nationality of three travelers cleared for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Notes delayed clearance and a letter to the Foreign Missions Conference seeking the travelers’ nationalities.

subfiles.title: Theater clearance for Powles, Foerstel and Powell
subfiles.from: John R. Millett, Joint Chiefs of Staff
subfiles.about: Confirms theater clearance and shipping allowances for three travelers to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Confirms entry clearance and authorizes space-available shipment of household goods, food and maintenance supplies.

subfiles.title: Telegram concerning Hounie's wife
subfiles.about: Declines to seek reconsideration of SCAP's refusal to admit Hounie's wife before he secures housing.
subfiles.summary: Explains that Hounie’s wife may reapply after he arranges living facilities and that the procedure is nondiscriminatory.

subfiles.title: Irish inquiry about the business-traveler quota
subfiles.about: Asks whether Ireland has received a quota for business representatives entering Japan.
subfiles.summary: Requests the size of Ireland’s allocation under the new business-traveler quota system.

subfiles.title: Conversation concerning Sister Marie de St. Joachim
subfiles.about: Confirms that Sister Marie de St. Joachim had already sailed with a SCAP reentry permit.
subfiles.summary: Mohler reports that the nun obtained clearance before leaving Japan and had already sailed back.

subfiles.title: Letter concerning Powles, Foerstel and Powell
subfiles.to: Foreign Missions Conference of North America
subfiles.about: Seeks nationality information and explains the passport procedures for three cleared travelers.
subfiles.summary: Requests nationality details and outlines separate documentation procedures for American and foreign citizens.

subfiles.title: Reply on Ireland's business quota
subfiles.about: Explains Ireland's allocation under the Inter-Allied Trade Board quota.
subfiles.summary: Ireland may designate one businessman for a 21-day visit, with replacement or extension subject to established procedures.

subfiles.title: Clearance for Faez Abdallah Ejel
subfiles.about: Reports no military objection to Ejel's three-week business visit to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Clears Ejel, requests his intended entry period and photographs, and explains extension procedures.

subfiles.title: Iraqi request for Edward Abdullah Ainy
subfiles.about: Transmits Ainy's application for a three-to-six-month business visit to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Requests assistance obtaining Japanese entry permission for Iraqi citizen Edward Abdullah Ainy.

subfiles.title: Edward Abdullah Ainy application
subfiles.from: Edward Abdullah Ainy via Embassy of Iraq
subfiles.about: Applies for entry to Tokyo as an Iraqi trade representative.
subfiles.summary: Ainy proposes an October or November sea journey to negotiate future Iraqi-Japanese business, requesting a three-to-six-month stay.

subfiles.title: Clearances for four missionaries
subfiles.about: Reports clearances for Martindale, Cermak, Hamelin and Mayo.
subfiles.summary: Confirms missionary clearances and authorizes revenue-basis surface transportation to Japan.

subfiles.title: Notice of Ainy's clearance
subfiles.about: Confirms Ainy's clearance and describes his required travel documentation.
subfiles.summary: Ainy may enter November 16–30 for 21 days under the trader quota. The note explains SCAP Circular No. 8 documentation and photograph requirements.

subfiles.title: Name check for Cermak, Hamelin and Mayo
subfiles.about: Records security searches for three missionaries.
subfiles.summary: Departmental file searches revealed no information about Cermak, Hamelin or Mayo.

subfiles.title: Cancellation of Sister Mary Martindale's trip
subfiles.about: Records that Sister Mary Martindale's convent cancelled her proposed journey.
subfiles.summary: Mohler states that Martindale no longer needs clearance because her convent cancelled the trip.

subfiles.title: Airgram on Sister Annette Hamelin
subfiles.about: Authorizes substitute documentation for Canadian missionary Annette Hamelin.
subfiles.summary: The consul may certify the airgram as Hamelin’s entry document because Canada lacks representation in Manila.

subfiles.title: Airgram on Sister Josefa Marco Yoke Mayo
subfiles.about: Communicates the Spanish missionary's clearance and documentation procedure.
subfiles.summary: Directs the Spanish Legation to issue Mayo a Circular No. 8 statement serving instead of a military permit.

subfiles.title: Airgram on Reverend Nicholas Cermak
subfiles.about: Communicates Cermak's missionary clearance and required Czech documentation.
subfiles.summary: Directs Czech authorities to give Cermak an English clearance statement in lieu of a military permit.

subfiles.title: Military permit for Edward Abdullah Ainy
subfiles.about: Authorizes Ainy's entry under the Japan Trader's Quota.
subfiles.summary: Permits one return journey to Japan for a 21-day trader-quota visit and requires two photographs.

subfiles.title: Swiss confirmation of Sister Reck's documentation
subfiles.about: Confirms that a Circular No. 8 statement was attached to Sister Reck's passport.
subfiles.summary: Reports completion of Sister Reck’s substitute military-permit documentation.

subfiles.title: Referral of Ainy's application to military authorities
subfiles.about: Forwards Ainy's application for consideration under the quota for other nations.
subfiles.summary: Requests SCAP consideration of Ainy under the Inter-Allied Trade Board’s residual business quota.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Ainy's application
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Ainy's application and reports its referral to military authorities.
subfiles.summary: Promises to notify the Iraqi Embassy when military authorities decide Ainy’s case.

subfiles.title: Name check for Edward Abdullah Ainy
subfiles.about: Records a departmental security search for Ainy.
subfiles.summary: Searches of Department files revealed no information concerning Ainy.

subfiles.title: Conversation announcing Ainy's clearance
subfiles.about: Notifies the Iraqi Embassy of Ainy's trader-quota clearance and documentation requirements.
subfiles.summary: Ainy may enter November 16–30 for 21 days; Iraqi authorities agree to document him under Circular No. 8.

subfiles.title: Telegram on William Keylard's clearance
subfiles.about: Communicates Keylard's clearance and requests Dutch substitute documentation.
subfiles.summary: Authorizes Keylard’s 21-day visit and directs the Netherlands Consulate General to issue his clearance statement.

subfiles.title: Routing memorandum for Keylard permit
subfiles.about: Forwards Keylard's permit and Commerce approval for action.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Keylard’s military permit and Commerce approval, identifying him as Dutch.

subfiles.title: Duplicate routing memorandum for Keylard
subfiles.about: Duplicates the memorandum forwarding Keylard's permit and Commerce approval.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate copy forwarding Keylard’s travel papers and noting his Dutch citizenship.

subfiles.title: William Keylard Commerce application
subfiles.about: Requests permission for Keylard to establish Japanese import and export contacts.
subfiles.summary: Keylard, a Dutch Far Eastern representative, proposes visiting Japanese industrial centers to buy and sell chemicals, pharmaceuticals, foodstuffs and raw materials.

subfiles.title: Request to place Keylard in an entry quota
subfiles.about: Requests Keylard's inclusion in a forthcoming Japan-entry quota.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Keylard’s permit and asks that his clearance be sent to Hong Kong.

subfiles.title: Return of Keylard's unused military permit
subfiles.about: Returns Keylard's permit after its information was transmitted to Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: Returns the unused permit because Dutch authorities in Hong Kong received the necessary clearance details.

subfiles.title: Lebanese request for Husni Halabi
subfiles.about: Requests a visa for Halabi to study trade possibilities in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Identifies Halabi as the Lebanese Ministry of National Economy’s prospective commercial representative.

subfiles.title: Referral of Halabi's application
subfiles.about: Forwards Halabi's application for consideration under the quota for other nations.
subfiles.summary: Requests SCAP review of Halabi as a Lebanese business representative.

subfiles.title: Clearances for six missionaries
subfiles.about: Reports entry clearance and shipping allowances for six missionaries.
subfiles.summary: Clears De Nervo, Yoshida, Gemeinder, Kircher, Ponzelet and Thoneick for missionary travel to Japan.

subfiles.title: Conversation on Faez Abdallah Ejel's travel date
subfiles.about: Notifies the Syrian Legation of Ejel's clearance and asks for his intended entry period.
subfiles.summary: Tomeh promises Ejel will provide his travel plans and confirms awareness of Circular No. 8 documentation.

subfiles.title: Routing memorandum for William Kenneth Clark
subfiles.about: Forwards Commerce documents concerning Clark's proposed Japan visit.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Clark’s Commerce certificate and letter, identifying him as Canadian.

subfiles.title: William Kenneth Clark Commerce application
subfiles.about: Requests a Japanese market survey for Swift-associated meat and by-product companies.
subfiles.summary: Clark proposes visiting Yokohama, Tokyo, Osaka and Kobe to reestablish prewar trade in meat, hides, tallow, bones and related products.

subfiles.title: Addendum to Clark's application
subfiles.about: Adds food-processing investigations and a tentative Asian-Pacific itinerary to Clark's application.
subfiles.summary: Expands the proposed visit to fish processing for export and outlines travel through Manila, Tokyo, Shanghai, Australia and New Zealand.

subfiles.title: Foreign Missions Conference reply on three Canadians
subfiles.about: Clarifies the nationality and status of Powles, Foerstel and Powell.
subfiles.summary: States that all three were Canadian subjects and had already been in Japan since May 31.

subfiles.title: Denial of Pedro Rionda's personal visit
subfiles.about: Rejects a proposed sightseeing visit by Pedro Rionda and his wife.
subfiles.summary: Existing regulations prohibit their personal visit to sightsee and pay respects to General MacArthur.

subfiles.title: Conversation on the Riondas' proposed visit
subfiles.about: Explains to the Philippine Embassy why the Riondas' sightseeing request would not be processed.
subfiles.summary: Castro accepts that military authorities will not process personal sightseeing visits.

subfiles.title: Return of Bertin Deveson's permit
subfiles.about: Returns Deveson's September permit and requests clearance for an October departure.
subfiles.summary: Deveson cannot use his original dates and hopes to sail from San Francisco on October 10.

subfiles.title: P. H. Andrews request to land in Japan
subfiles.about: Requests permission for Andrews and his wife to land briefly while sailing to Singapore.
subfiles.summary: The retired Malayan Police officer asks to visit Kobe or Yokohama during the Marine Swallow’s port call, citing his wartime internment by Japan.

subfiles.title: Shanghai telegram concerning Victor Salim Reuben
subfiles.about: Reports Reuben's request to investigate trade opportunities in Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Iraqi trader seeks entry after apparent Department of Commerce approval.

subfiles.title: Name check for Victor Salim Reuben
subfiles.about: Records departmental searches for adverse information on Reuben.
subfiles.summary: The name check found no adverse information concerning Reuben.

subfiles.title: Military permit for Victor S. Ruben
subfiles.about: Authorizes Ruben's entry under the Japan Trader's Quota.
subfiles.summary: Permits entry from October 16 for a 21-day trader-quota visit and requires two passport photographs.

subfiles.title: Airgram confirming Reuben's clearance
subfiles.about: Confirms Reuben's entry period and substitute documentation procedure.
subfiles.summary: Reuben may enter October 16–30 for 21 days; the consulate should issue a Circular No. 8 statement.

subfiles.title: Conversation establishing Ejel's entry window
subfiles.about: Records Ejel's requested November–December entry period and notification to military authorities.
subfiles.summary: Ramsey agrees to notify SCAP of an approximate November 28 arrival and authorizes Ejel to proceed.

subfiles.title: Substitution of Reuben for Morris Hirsch
subfiles.about: Forwards the Commerce approval originally issued to Hirsch and records Reuben's substitution.
subfiles.summary: Notes that Iraqi citizen Victor Reuben replaced Morris Hirsch as the company’s proposed traveler.

subfiles.title: Morris Hirsch Commerce application
subfiles.about: Requests permission to visit Kobe and reestablish the Reuben firm's former office and contacts.
subfiles.summary: The application describes the company’s textile, hosiery, shellac, spice and notion trade and its prewar Kobe office.

subfiles.title: Report on the Fushimi brothers' repatriation
subfiles.about: Reports on Julio and Alfonso Fushimi's circumstances and possible return to Argentina.
subfiles.summary: Julio wants repatriation but awaits Argentine documentation and transportation arrangements. Alfonso, a former Japanese naval cadet, is uncertain of his citizenship and does not presently wish to return; neither faces an American objection to departure.

subfiles.title: Request for missionary military permits
subfiles.about: Requests permits for five cleared missionaries but excludes Sister Lucie De Nervo.
subfiles.summary: Requests permits for Yoshida, Gemeinder, Kircher, Ponzelet and Thoneick; De Nervo has separate arrangements.

subfiles.title: Conversation concerning Sister Lucie De Nervo
subfiles.about: Confirms that De Nervo was already sailing to Japan with military clearance.
subfiles.summary: Mohler reports De Nervo already at sea, allowing the Department to close her case.

subfiles.title: Name checks for six missionaries
subfiles.about: Records security searches for Yoshida, De Nervo and four German missionaries.
subfiles.summary: Departmental searches found no information concerning any of the six missionaries.

subfiles.title: Conversation concerning Soubra's entry date
subfiles.about: Requests Soubra's travel plans after SCAP clearance.
subfiles.summary: Mattar asks that documentation await Soubra’s arrival from Lebanon and promises to report his intended entry date.

subfiles.title: Routing memorandum on the Fushimi repatriation reply
subfiles.about: Recommends signing a draft note communicating the Yokohama report to Argentina.
subfiles.summary: Recommends approval of the draft response concerning possible Fushimi repatriation.

subfiles.title: Note to Argentina on the Fushimi brothers
subfiles.about: Transmits the Yokohama report on Julio and Alfonso Fushimi.
subfiles.summary: Julio wants to return but needs Argentine instructions, documentation and transportation funding. Alfonso is uncertain of his citizenship and presently declines repatriation; the United States raises no objection to either departure and offers further assistance.

subfiles.title: Clearances for Kakimori, de Changy and Tellen
subfiles.about: Reports entry clearances for three missionaries in Argentina and China.
subfiles.summary: Clears Kakimori, de Changy and Tellen and authorizes revenue-basis surface transportation.

subfiles.title: Name checks for Kakimori, de Changy and Tellen
subfiles.about: Records departmental security searches for three missionaries.
subfiles.summary: No information was found concerning Kakimori, de Changy or Tellen.

subfiles.title: Airgram on Reverend Kakimori
subfiles.about: Communicates Kakimori's missionary clearance and asks for his travel plans.
subfiles.summary: The embassy should notify him, obtain his entry date and arrange an exit permit if he transits the United States.

subfiles.title: Request for Kakimori's military permit
subfiles.about: Requests a permit for Kakimori while explaining why the other two missionaries need none.
subfiles.summary: Kakimori needs a permit for delivery in the United States; de Changy and Tellen will receive clearance by other means.

subfiles.title: Airgram on Adrienne Wada and her son
subfiles.about: Communicates the Wadas' clearance and Austrian documentation procedure.
subfiles.summary: The Austrian Legation should issue mother and son Circular No. 8 statements for travel to join her husband.

subfiles.title: War Department memorandum on the Wadas
subfiles.about: Encloses a permit for Wada and her son and states the transportation condition.
subfiles.summary: SCAP has no objection provided their transportation costs the United States nothing.

subfiles.title: Military permit for Adrienne Franziska Wada
subfiles.about: Authorizes Wada's entry into Japan to join her husband.
subfiles.summary: Permit issued to Adrienne Franziska Wada, née Frankel, for family reunification in Japan.

subfiles.title: File memorandum on Wada's address and documentation
subfiles.about: Explains why clearance was sent to The Hague and how Wada should be documented.
subfiles.summary: Uses Wada’s latest Hague address and assigns passport certification to the Austrian Legation there.

subfiles.title: Norbert Propper transit-permit request
subfiles.about: Requests authorization for an airline stop in Tokyo while traveling to Manila.
subfiles.summary: The Polish citizen seeks a transit permit and states that he will not remain in Japan.

subfiles.title: Shanghai telegram concerning Helen Zarnack
subfiles.about: Requests Japan-entry permission for a German YWCA secretary attending an international delegation.
subfiles.summary: The traveler expects to fly in early November but holds a temporary Berlin document not validated for Japan.

subfiles.title: Authorization for consular issuance of transit clearances
subfiles.about: Approves limited consular authorization for foreign nationals transiting Japan by commercial aircraft.
subfiles.summary: Selected consuls may clear brief refueling or emergency stops, with travelers subject to SCAP rules and carrier supervision.

subfiles.title: Interim reply on Manila transit authority
subfiles.about: Reports that SCAP is being consulted about passport validation for transit.
subfiles.summary: Tells Manila to await instructions while the Department queries SCAP.

subfiles.title: Manila inquiry on alien transit passports
subfiles.about: Asks whether the consulate may validate alien passports for air transit through Japan.
subfiles.summary: Requests confirmation that transit-validation authority covers aliens as well as Americans.
